decisions.reason: The online customer portal lies far from the firm's display-making knowledge, so it is harder to evaluate and improve, but it supports customer service around the core business and fits the firm's push toward digital collaboration and information security, so the firm will likely keep it for now.
The packaging display builds directly on the firm's core cardboard display expertise and in-house R&D, and it won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, so it is very likely to be kept.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the firm's established offer and has its own website page, so the firm can readily interpret results and refine it.
The counter display is a standard format squarely within the firm's display competence, and absorptive capacity favours keeping and improving it.
The freestanding information display is close to the core business and fits the strategy of broader 3D cardboard offerings, though such display variants can be rotated out like Product A.
